easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Doppelganger
description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Vesuvan Doppelganger into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Doppelganger's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.
